title: SFX issue
author: Minute_Watercress_21
selftext:
Hey guys, I'm currently trying to develop my first game, i've done everything with AI so far with barely no pre existing assets but i'm a bit stuck on the SFX matter, for my animations the 3d is pretty decent so far but i dont know how to generate sounds, what i've achieved is really bad and what i've found on free library doesnt match what i'm expecting do you guys have any ideas ? (I have a REALLY tight budget, i just paid for the 6 dollar tripo student subscription for the moment lol) 

Thanks

comments.author: Manifesto-Engine
comments.body: Editors! have the AI make editors for these items.

replies.author: Minute_Watercress_21
replies.body: you had some good results with this method ? Where do you find the sound that you are supposed to edit with the AI built editor ?

replies.author: Manifesto-Engine
replies.body:
You don’t necessarily need a source sound. The editor can *generate* the sound itself from oscillators/noise, envelopes, filters, impacts, etc. Think of it more like building a tiny synthesizer specifically for game SFX.

You can also give it sample import if you want, so you could grab/record a basic sound and then layer/process it. The main advantage is you stop hunting for the exact sound and start shaping it yourself.

replies.author: Minute_Watercress_21
replies.body: ok i get it, i'll try that, do you have something in mind to get sounds such as a phenix ? probably free sound of exotic bird i guess ?
